instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging program. Fuel cost is primarily pass-through under capacity purchase agreements with major airline partners (United, Delta, American, Alaska and others). SKYW bears fuel risk only on pro-rate operations.

warnings: Fuel cost is primarily pass-through to major airline partners under capacity purchase agreements. United, Delta, American, Alaska bear fuel risk for contracted flights. SKYW bears fuel risk on pro-rate operations (~16% of revenue). Avg price $2.49/gal in 2021. No hedging program.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons purchased: 43,059 thousand gallons (fiscal year ended December 31, 2021) from Item 7 table. Note: SkyWest prorate gallons only.
